page: Microsoft Azure L32as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing an x86_64 AMD processor. This virtual machine runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 32 dedicated vCPUs. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A primary feature of this server configuration is its storage capacity. The instance includes 7679 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. There are no integrated GPUs, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high ratio of memory to vCPUs combined with extensive local storage capacity makes this server type appropriate for storage-heavy and database workloads. The lack of dedicated GPU hardware limits its utility for accelerated machine learning or graphics rendering tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities for large-scale database operations, data warehousing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
